rules: A later group is new prospective evidence, never a retry of a prior output.
A group must bind framework/version, task, roles, subject, action contract, checkpoint schema, monitor rules, package rules and repair contract.
A change to any scientific input requires a new explicit contract version.
No group may replace, overwrite or back-fill an earlier group's raw evidence.
Replicate groups may be added only when scientifically or review-wise useful; repeated sampling is not used to manufacture determinism.
